authority.human: selects account, contract, operating mode, and may submit manual intent
authority.hermes: owns probabilistic market judgment and trade intent
authority.glitch: owns truthful ProjectX evidence, identity, execution, protection, reconciliation, and receipts
authority.deterministic_rejection: limited to factual execution invalidity, authoritative venue/account boundaries, unprovable ownership or protection, duplicate or ambiguous mutation, and explicit operator disablement
authority.forbidden: hidden strategy gates, arbitrary risk preferences, trade creation without human or Hermes intent, and intent mutation outside the requested range

items.title: Keep quiet-tape evidence in Hermes cognition, not the execution gate
acceptance: Configured armed mode remains armed when reconciled venue state is current and the 60-second tape contains zero prints.
Decision packets retain the full rolling order-flow observation and trade count.
No tape, spread, depth, volatility, session, or confidence observation independently authorizes or forbids entry.
Quote freshness, reconciliation, capacity, recovery, ownership, protection, and explicit operator mode remain factual gates.
EXIT remains available under entry-only degraded state.
evidence: src/execution/gateway-mode.ts removes order_flow_trades_60s and order_flow_no_trades_60s from execution admission.
tests/gateway-mode.test.ts proves quiet tape is preserved as evidence and cannot select an action.
